author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Anbernic RG DS continues its ascent into one of the nicer sub-$100 handheld releases of 2026, thanks to continued firmware updates from Anbernic and the community.  Let's take a look at some recent Linux firmware improvements, including better dual-screen functionality.

Buy an Anbernic RG DS:
AliExpress: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3rcftQ7
Amazon: https://amzn.to/4rKt1R2
Anbernic direct: https://tinyurl.com/RGDS-RGC

Previous RG DS videos:
Review video: https://youtu.be/MFu4goCqEko
Android/Linux update video: https://youtu.be/U0eckrNxbzY

Dual-screen ROCKNIX themes:
DII ESS AYE: https://github.com/beebono/dii-ess-aye
Canvas DS: https://github.com/toniremi/canvas-ds

Anbernic Linux OS: https://win.anbernic.com/download/640.html
Rufus software: https://rufus.ie/en/
TinyScraper for RGDS: https://github.com/wang1025475397/tiny-scraper-by-libretro

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/
